## Problem and evidence
Explain what this change fixes, with an issue or reproducible example.

## Validation
- [ ] I ran `python -m pytest -q tests/`.
- [ ] I included a regression test or explained why none is applicable.
- [ ] I identified evidence as mocked, synthetic, real model, or real repository code.
- [ ] I checked that no secrets, personal information, or private source were committed.
- [ ] I understand human review is required and there is no auto-merge.

## Scope and limitations
List which files changed, what is not verified and any runner/API costs.
